_about: Sessellift FGD-2 fixed-grip double (v0.3.2, owner LD1): the FGQ-4 at an 11 ft line gauge, by rule (liftkit/gauge.py). The terminals' hood, piers and housing keep the quad's size; the crossbeams, lifting portals, bullwheels and sheave rows follow the gauge (owner LD5, Q1). The chair is the quad's narrowed to two seats (assets/chair.py derive). Rope sockets and sheaves keep the quad's 1 3/4 in rope (LD7). Millimetres.
